description: This file defines a TorchScript-compatible implementation of a functional AdamW optimizer for distributed training in PyTorch. It includes a class `_FunctionalAdamW` with methods to initialize and perform optimizer steps, leveraging TorchScript for JIT compilation and efficiency in distributed settings.

classes.name: _FunctionalAdamW
classes.description: A TorchScript-compiled class implementing a functional AdamW optimizer tailored for distributed training scenarios.

methods.description: Initializes the `_FunctionalAdamW` optimizer with specified hyperparameters, performing validation and setting up internal state.

methods.name: step_param(self, param: Tensor, grad: Tensor | None)
methods.description: Performs an optimizer step on a single parameter tensor with its gradient, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: step(self, gradients: list[Tensor | None])
methods.description: Performs a distributed optimizer step on a list of gradients corresponding to the parameter list, updating parameters using TorchScript-compiled code.
